article.title: Cira Pascual Marquina: Building international solidarity from a Venezuelan commune
article.author: Editor
article.content: A Marxist internationalist activist and Venezuelan at heart. For 20 years in Caracas, Cira has built community and solidarity rooted in activism, education and friendship. The post Cira Pascual Marquina: Building international solidarity from a Venezuelan commune appeared first on MR Online .
